reason: I would like the paint protection on the M4, but this is a new app with the first partners only just being added, so I have no Google ratings or photos of their work to check. I would rather pay the installer cash or after the job than pay online first.
objection: I cannot see the shop, its reviews or its finished cars before I pay, and a brand-new platform with no track record yet is the thing that worries me most.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a partner near me with real Google ratings and photos of finished BMW jobs, plus a few reviews from people who have already used ArmorHub.
